channel.desc: Jariah's ex-boyfriend, Stedman, had a baby with Jariah's best friend, Tykena -- and Tykena believes there's more he's not telling; after an extensive genealogy search, Carla uncovers a potential sister named Chrystal, and the women believe they share the same father, who is not the man Carla always believed was her dad.
